name: Leann sins
source: Leann sins is a story of lust, betrayal, and forbidden desires. Leann Cassidy, a famous photo model, lives a glamorous life but hides her unfulfilled cravings. With her husband unable to satisfy all her needs, Leann ventures into a world of temptations where moral boundaries blur.
